from solution import multiple_to_single


def test_issue_example_given():
    """Example [11, 33, 50] converts to 113350."""
    # "11" + "33" + "50" = "113350" = 113350
    assert multiple_to_single([11, 33, 50]) == 113350


def test_issue_single_element():
    """A single-element list converts to that integer."""
    # "7" = 7
    assert multiple_to_single([7]) == 7


def test_issue_two_single_digits():
    """Two single digits concatenate into one integer."""
    # "1" + "2" = "12" = 12
    assert multiple_to_single([1, 2]) == 12


def test_issue_boundary_single_to_double_digits():
    """Values just below and above 10 concatenate by decimal text."""
    # "9" + "10" = "910" = 910
    assert multiple_to_single([9, 10]) == 910


def test_issue_boundary_double_to_triple_digits():
    """Values just below and above 100 concatenate by decimal text."""
    # "99" + "100" = "99100" = 99100
    assert multiple_to_single([99, 100]) == 99100


def test_issue_single_zero():
    """List [0] converts to single integer 0."""
    # "0" = 0
    assert multiple_to_single([0]) == 0


def test_issue_trailing_zero():
    """Trailing zero element is kept as a digit."""
    # "12" + "0" = "120" = 120
    assert multiple_to_single([12, 0]) == 120


def test_issue_three_multi_digit_elements():
    """Three multi-digit elements concatenate in order."""
    # "10" + "20" + "30" = "102030" = 102030
    assert multiple_to_single([10, 20, 30]) == 102030


def test_issue_four_elements_varying_widths():
    """Elements of widths 1, 2, 3, 4 concatenate in order."""
    # "1" + "22" + "333" + "4444" = "1223334444" = 1223334444
    assert multiple_to_single([1, 22, 333, 4444]) == 1223334444


def test_contract_returns_single_int():
    """Result must be a single integer."""
    assert isinstance(multiple_to_single([11, 33, 50]), int)


def test_contract_preserves_input_order():
    """Element order determines digit order in the result."""
    # "12"+"34"="1234" versus "34"+"12"="3412", so results differ
    assert multiple_to_single([12, 34]) != multiple_to_single([34, 12])
